 Hollywood actor Michael Douglas attended the Tibet House US Art of Freedom Gala 2026, accompanied by his younger children with actress Catherine Zeta-Jones — his 26-year-old son Dylan and 23-year-old daughter Caris.  
 The actor’s appearance with his children came amid his public remarks during the promotion of his memoir, *One Helluva Ride*, in which he criticized the term “nepo baby,” noting that nepotism exists in many professions and that his own grandfather was a rag dealer. 
 Both of Douglas’s younger children attended Brown University: Dylan studied political science, and Keris studied film and international relations.
 Source: Daily Mail .
 As a reminder, American actor and producer Michael Douglas arrived in Kyiv on September 10, 2024. He has actively supported Ukraine since the start of the full-scale Russian invasion.
 Earlier, CORE, the foundation of actor and director Sean Penn in Ukraine, announced that it would provide Lviv with $100,000 to help rebuild homes damaged by Russian attacks.
